group_a_shilora_stones.source: SHILORA Inscription Field Survey & Targeted Epigraphical Archive
group_a_shilora_stones.pipeline: RAW STONE IMAGE -> ADAPTIVE SHILORA PREPROCESSING (Relief Amplification, Illumination Equalization, Bilateral Filtering, CLAHE) -> SHILALEKHYA ATTENTION U-NET BINARIZATION
group_a_shilora_stones.deterministic_guarantee: No generative synthesis or stroke fabrication. Natural photometric relief enhancement only.

group_b_conserved_episam_stones.pipeline: HISTORICAL DIRECT BINARIZATION / PRE-PREPARED CONSERVATION DERIVATIVES -> SHILALEKHYA BINARIZATION & EPISAM GROUND TRUTH DERIVATION
group_b_conserved_episam_stones.note: Historically conserved 3D photometric stereo scans prepared under direct epigraphical conservation protocol.

flow: 1. User uploads arbitrary JPEG/PNG image via POST /api/shilora/analyze
2. Image written to secure temporary staging
3. ShiloraStonePreprocessor.process() performs adaptive relief amplification & local illumination normalization
4. Preprocessed image (final_natural) passed directly to EpiSAMBinarizer (models/shilalekhya/binarizer.pth)
5. Quality Gate inspects foreground density (0.005 <= fg_ratio <= 0.40) and connected component candidates (>= 3)
6. Validated mask passed to EpiSAM ViT-B (models/episam/episam.pth) for dynamic character segmentation
7. Spatial grouping & line reconstruction produces clean line crops
8. Fine-tuned TrOCR transcribe lines to raw Old Kannada text
9. Deterministic translation engine applies epigraphical lexicon & morphology
